visual_brief.subject: OpenAI frontier models enter private preview on Google Cloud
verified_context: Google Cloud and OpenAI announced a new enterprise distribution route on October 21.
Google lists GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Luna in a private preview for selected customers through Model Garden.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: Verify preview eligibility, API compatibility, regional and data-boundary terms, identity integration and portability before treating the route as equivalent to OpenAI's direct API.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: a terracotta passage between two distinct stone porticoes
must_show: a terracotta passage between two distinct stone porticoes

candidate_notes.A: The monumental boulder crossing is dramatic but overstates the quiet procurement theme.
candidate_notes.B: Selected: the terracotta bridge joins distinct stone gateways, keeping distribution separate from a new-model claim.
candidate_notes.C: The corridor reads as generic infrastructure more readily than a new access route.

crop_review.article_desktop: Both stone gateways and the joining bridge survive the wide crop.
crop_review.article_mobile: The bridge and distinct endpoints remain legible on mobile.
crop_review.thumbnail: The bridge remains the dominant shape at listing size. The unused square crop loses the outer gateways; this asset is not the home feature.

golden_reference_comparison: Compared side by side with the Claude plugin ecosystem and Copilot review controls golden images. The selected candidate shares their warm paper field, restrained stone/metal materiality, terracotta emphasis and substantial architectural forms. Selected: the terracotta bridge joins distinct stone gateways, keeping distribution separate from a new-model claim.

generation_metadata.visual_review: Contact sheets with both golden references and actual center-cover crop sheets inspected by model self-review. Pillow fallback used after Chromium download failed; no browser screenshot review is claimed.

candidate_prompts.A:
Create one editorial illustration for The Daily AI Pulse. Placement: article hero, also used as an edition/listing image. Output crop: wide 16:9, high-resolution landscape. Subject: OpenAI frontier models enter private preview on Google Cloud. Verified context: Google Cloud and OpenAI announced a new enterprise distribution route on October 21. Google lists GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Luna in a private preview for selected customers through Model Garden. Visual idea: a terracotta passage between two distinct stone porticoes. Candidate A composition: Two different monumental stone porticoes joined by one narrow terracotta passage, viewed obliquely; a single sculptural piece crosses between them. Calm wide spatial depth. Keep the focal metaphor in the central 55 percent so it survives desktop wide cover, a mobile near-square cover and a 320px thumbnail. The website renders all text separately.
Art direction: a restrained contemporary editorial illustration with a quiet scientific or architectural sensibility. Deliberate geometry, fine lines supporting substantial forms, subtle paper grain, warm stone/plaster and brushed metal, controlled depth, spacious negative space and strong contrast. Warm canvas #F3EBDD, paper #FAF6EE, near-black ink #171B1A, muted gray #575D5B and sparing terracotta #8A4B35. Match the visual family of tactile engraved architectural editorial illustrations, not a glossy 3D product render. The subject must survive object-fit: cover. Physical/spatial presence and a memorable silhouette are essential. Treat the scene as an abstract metaphor, not a claimed engineering architecture or biological result.
No words, letters, numbers, labels, logos, interface elements, page header, footer, buttons, badges, charts with invented data, watermark, neon effects, robots, or generic glowing AI brains. Do not generate a headline or imitate a screenshot. Do not produce a bare schematic, flowchart, wireframe, icon composition, or minimalist architecture diagram. Fine technical lines may support the composition but must not be the composition itself. No border or frame.
